entries.note: The page's first step on a delivery, dated with the shipment's creation until a status of its own dates it.
At Closer's warehouse: before a delivery round, back after a failed one, or with a collected return.
The parcel goes back to the warehouse and out again. The reason of the shipment's latest incidence, dated like the attempt, follows the wording.
A return the driver is to collect from the customer, the first step of a pickup in the tracking page's script; the page then shows the driver's way there.
A return collected from the customer, in the tracking page's script.
The driver could not collect the return, which stays with the customer. In the tracking page's script.
On a delivery, the parcel goes back to the shop and the page says it could not be delivered. On a pickup it is the collected return's next leg, in transit. In the tracking page's script.
Back with the shop, a failed delivery or a customer's return alike. In the tracking page's script.
Quoted in a review on Closer Logistics' Trustpilot page; also named in a public OCU complaint.
